objectives.description: Add scripts/measure-gate-costs.sh with per-gate timing, 2+ runs
objectives.note: DEVIATION: used date +%s%3N wall-clock delta (matching run-all.sh's own proven technique) instead of /usr/bin/time, which does not exist as that literal path on this NixOS measurement host (confirmed live).

objectives.description: Guard harness: refuse measurement above load threshold
Emit per-gate cost model data file + regenerate suite-cost-hints.txt via run-all.sh --timings
objectives.note: Per-gate CSV (23 gates) captured fully idle and clean on the second attempt (1min load 1.03 at start, 1.15 at end; first full-sweep attempt was contaminated by a severe live contention spike, load 50+, caused by concurrent sibling /orchestrate sessions -- discarded, not merged). suite-cost-hints.txt regeneration required 3 attempts due to recurring mild tail-end load creep (2.4-2.6 right at completion of the ~10min sequential 2x147-suite sweep); accepted the 3rd attempt's result as advisory-only data per its own documented nature, with the caveat recorded here that test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh's 228.6s figure in that file specifically should be treated with caution (its nested verify-deploy.sh invocations are disproportionately contention-sensitive) -- the clean, authoritative per-gate model is gate-cost-model.csv, not this file.

objectives.description: Assign cost class (free/moderate/slow) with boundaries in header
Take the idle measurement, record resulting table (23 gates + Gate 3 + 6/7/9/10/11/21/23 cluster itemized)
objectives.note: Table: gate1=10ms free, gate2=27ms free, gate3=125669ms slow, gate4=13123ms moderate, gate5=296ms free, gate6=6438ms moderate, gate7=1847ms free, gate8=457197ms slow, gate9=388ms free, gate10=6088ms moderate, gate11=88ms free, gate12=4613ms moderate, gate13=267ms free, gate14=537ms free, gate15=496ms free, gate16=63ms free, gate17=11770ms moderate, gate18=1976ms free, gate19=377ms free, gate20=412ms free, gate21=3683ms moderate, gate22=54716ms slow, gate23=3755ms moderate. Gate 3 explicitly included (125.7s, closely matching the research's carried-unverified 124.2s figure). The 6/7/9/10/11/21/23 cluster itemized individually: gate6=6438, gate7=1847, gate9=388, gate10=6088, gate11=88, gate21=3683, gate23=3755 (sum 20287ms) -- far more granular than the research's aggregate 51.6s figure for this cluster, and confirms the cluster is NOT uniformly costly (gate9/gate11 are free; gate6/gate10/gate21/gate23 are moderate).

objectives.description: Add test-measure-gate-costs.sh covering load guard, averaging, unhinted-suite append invariant

deviations.description: Add scripts/measure-gate-costs.sh: for each gate id, run verify-deploy.sh --only-gate N <target> under /usr/bin/time, at least twice, emit a machine-readable per-gate cost row.
deviations.reason: /usr/bin/time does not exist as that literal path on this NixOS measurement host (only a PATH-resolved Nix store binary) -- confirmed live before writing the script. Used date +%s%3N wall-clock delta instead, the exact technique tests/run-all.sh already uses for its own per-suite timings -- portable, proven, and already audited in this codebase.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- /usr/bin/time replaced by date +%s%3N wall-clock delta, see progress file)*
